notes: This is a metric dictionary, not an observed utilization dataset.
A publication row names one numerator, denominator, measurement window, and evidentiary boundary.
Compute Bazaar does not infer rented capacity from disappearing offers or hardware activity from a running lease.

rows.definition: Share of repeated source checks in which at least one eligible GPU instance could be rented.
rows.denominator: all scheduled source checks in the reporting window
rows.measurement_window: repeated checks aggregated over a declared interval
rows.numerator: checks with at least one eligible rentable instance
rows.source_label: Foundry Signals GPU Availability Index methodology
rows.what_it_does_not_support: It does not count installed GPUs, transactions, rented capacity, or hardware activity.
rows.what_it_supports: How often an eligible offer was obtainable under the stated polling rule.

rows.definition: Share of the measured GPU population that is currently rented.
rows.denominator_disclosure: the public endpoint defines the ratio but does not fully disclose population construction
rows.measurement_window: point-in-time ratio retained through an hourly market series
rows.what_it_does_not_support: It does not show whether kernels, tensor cores, or memory were active after the rental began.
rows.what_it_supports: Commercial occupancy and demand for measured rentable capacity.

rows.definition: Share of schedulable resource capacity committed to workload requests.
rows.examples: Kubernetes requests, VM assignments, sandbox reservations
rows.measurement_window: scheduler state over a declared interval
rows.numerator: resource units assigned or requested by scheduled workloads
rows.what_it_does_not_support: It does not show actual CPU, memory, or accelerator activity.
rows.what_it_supports: How much scheduler capacity is unavailable for another workload.

rows.definition: Share of a measurement interval in which the relevant processor engine was active.
rows.denominator: all sampled time or cycles in the measurement interval
rows.examples: GPU engine, SM, tensor, DRAM, VM CPU, sandbox CPU
rows.measurement_window: sampled telemetry aggregated over a declared workload window
rows.numerator: sampled time or cycles with the selected processor engine active
rows.what_it_does_not_support: Engine activity alone does not prove high occupancy, efficient execution, or useful output.
rows.what_it_supports: Whether a measured hardware engine was busy during the sampled interval.

rows.definition: Rate of completed workload units that satisfy an explicitly declared service objective.
rows.denominator_disclosure: the service objective and accepted unit must be declared by the measurement
rows.examples: completed jobs, requests, or tokens meeting latency and correctness rules
rows.measurement_window: request or job outcomes aggregated over a declared interval
rows.numerator: completed workload units meeting the declared service objective
rows.source_label: Revisiting SLO and Goodput Metrics in LLM Serving
rows.what_it_does_not_support: It is not a fleet rental ratio and cannot be compared without the same output and service objective.
rows.what_it_supports: Work delivered at the quality or latency level the application actually requires.

rows.definition: Percentage of allocated EC2 compute units currently in use by one instance.
rows.denominator: allocated EC2 compute units for the instance
rows.numerator: allocated EC2 compute units currently in use
rows.what_it_does_not_support: A low or high value does not say whether the VM is leased or whether its work is useful.
rows.what_it_supports: CPU-cycle use relative to the compute allocated to one running instance.

rows.definition: Timestamped CPU, memory, and disk usage observed inside one running sandbox.
rows.denominator: the sandbox CPU, memory, or disk quantity exposed by the metric
rows.examples: E2B CPU, memory, and disk samples
rows.measurement_window: five-second samples during a running sandbox
rows.numerator: CPU time or memory and disk bytes reported as used
rows.what_it_does_not_support: One customer's sandbox telemetry does not reveal the provider fleet's rented share or utilization.
rows.what_it_supports: Resource activity for the measured sandbox during its retained samples.

rows.definition: Processor and memory billing based on the higher of requested resources or actual usage.
rows.denominator: billable sandbox duration and resource quantity
rows.examples: Modal sandbox processor and memory billing
rows.numerator: maximum of requested and actual resource use
rows.what_it_does_not_support: A billed resource quantity is not itself market occupancy or hardware activity.
rows.what_it_supports: Why sandbox cost can follow requested capacity even when activity is lower.
